observed_events.description: The players are playing classic UNO: dealt and held cards show UNO faces, and the face-down draw pile shows black backs with the red UNO oval.

Around 154 s the woman sets one card on the table by itself, to the left of the draw and discard piles. It is a classic Wild Draw Four (four-colour 'Wild' oval with 'Draw Four' banners top and bottom); it stays face-up there while the camera wearer reads the printed rules leaflet. It is absent in the 150 s frame.

construct.research_question: Can an Agent identify the game and the specific card from the scene to narrow an initially valid rules video to the card the user is asking about?
construct.belief_before: A whole-game classic UNO rules video is a valid saved video before the card is set down.
construct.belief_after: A admits English videos on the rules of classic UNO, whole-game or single-rule; it excludes other card games, UNO editions/themed decks with different cards, gameplay/entertainment and non-English videos. B admits only videos whose public title, description or chapters are about the Wild Draw Four card alone (its legality and challenge); whole-game rule videos with a Draw Four chapter and other single-card videos are initial-only. The UNO! Mobile platform is not part of the need when the video teaches the same official rule.
construct.required_behavior_change: A admits English videos on the rules of classic UNO, whole-game or single-rule; it excludes other card games, UNO editions/themed decks with different cards, gameplay/entertainment and non-English videos. B admits only videos whose public title, description or chapters are about the Wild Draw Four card alone (its legality and challenge); whole-game rule videos with a Draw Four chapter and other single-card videos are initial-only. The UNO! Mobile platform is not part of the need when the video teaches the same official rule.
construct.no_update_failure: The Agent keeps a whole-game UNO rules video after the user asks for a video about just that card.
construct.overupdate_failure: The Agent saves a video about a different card (e.g. Draw Two) or another UNO edition's wild card, or leaves the old video saved as well.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The players are playing classic UNO: dealt and held cards show UNO faces, and the face-down draw pile shows black backs with the red UNO oval. Around 154 s the woman sets one card on the table by itself, to the left of the draw and discard piles. It is a classic Wild Draw Four (four-colour 'Wild' oval with 'Draw Four' banners top and bottom); it stays face-up there while the camera wearer reads the printed rules leaflet. It is absent in the 150 s frame. The text names neither the game nor the card.
